additional_info.subject: 0442656 - ID0442656/DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / P4 170000481]Connectors are faulted CRM:00314000208
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon colleagues,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services team in regards of ticket
ID0442656.
The ticket has been opened by Mr. Scheenloop for an HW issue on charger
MP/P4 170000481.
By checking the charger on SCB, I can see the following critical error flag:
12VDC_Supply_TB18_FC23
PLC
DEVICE
true
problem with TB18 or FC23
The charger has an issue on the 12V line, and because of this all the outlets are currently out of order. Please organize a site visit and, according to the electrical scheme below, check:
That FC23 is in on position
That the 230Ac supply comes correctly to QA25 and arrives to TB18
That TB18 is working properly.
From experience on other chargers, it might be required to eventually replace TB18 component. Here is the MLFB for your convenience:
Since an onsite visit is required, I am moving
case
0442656
